topics.purpose: Define immutable validation evidence containing exact source snapshot, format profile, structural/semantic findings, severity and readiness impact.

semantics.identity_rule: Each validation run/report has an explicit identity.
semantics.snapshot_rule: Report references exact active/candidate source-set snapshot.
semantics.format_rule: Bootstrapped Contract Format identity/version is exact.
semantics.finding_rule: Each finding has exact contract/path/rule/severity refs.
semantics.readiness_rule: Readiness impact is explicit per finding/profile.
semantics.history_rule: Validation reports are evidence and remain historical.
semantics.authority_rule: A clean report does not itself activate runtime or apply candidate changes.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority, canonical contract sources, generated projections, historical artifacts and runtime state remain separate identities/roles; no file becomes authoritative merely by name, path order, timestamp or discovery order.
Candidate canonical changes remain inert until exact format validation, identity/reference resolution, semantic diff, applicable governance/authorization and repository acceptance succeed.
